result:
I've planned round 296 as **STUDIO-LINK-a**, and the decision is **CONTINUE**. Round 295 passed C's check and has been published, so nothing from it is left open. No app code was changed, and the store working tree is clean.

**Round 295 closed (from C's results only)**
- C passed all 10 rows, with real browser checks run. Gate 295 published `eded57a` on both remotes.
- SYS-VACUOUS-ROWS is marked done, and its four Low findings are closed.
- A stopped the round because two claim differences were missing from my task's allowed list. Both came from my own task text, so I ruled them accepted. From now on, the allowed differences come from running the claims script on my pre-applied copy, not from a hand-written list.
- The gate reviewer's one Low finding (the stricter perf check could raise false alarms) is deferred. Its note that `perf/**` is not linted is added to the existing root request about test and lint coverage.
- No Critical, High or Medium findings are open. `regression-last.json` is unchanged.

**Round 296: product page link into the Studio**
- On a product page, a quiet "Try it in the Studio" text link sits under the title. It opens `/studio-lab?preview=middle-east` with that preview selected and focused in the library. Enter adds it to a lane; nothing is added automatically and no status text is written.
- Only Middle East has a preview inside the Studio demo today, so it is the only product that shows the link; other products show none. Loading any product's own preview would need the backend and an unverified cross-origin (R2) check, so I recorded that as a later candidate (STUDIO-LINK-DYNAMIC).
- A changes 10 files: a new handle-to-source map, one optional prop on the Studio context, the `studio-lab` route, `ProductSidebar.tsx`, one mock line in each of four route test files, a new test file and doc 220. No protected file is touched, and naming stays with NAME-AND-HINT.
- I tried the change on a scratch copy first:
  - Adding the URL parameter breaks four existing route tests, so the task grants those files one mock line each.
  - 89 tests pass and typecheck is clean.
  - Four deliberately broken versions each turn their tests red.
  - In real Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720: the link appears on Middle East only, the Middle East preview is focused when the Studio opens, and Enter adds it. HEAD has no link.
- C checks the link (mouse and keyboard), the Studio landing, Enter → clip → undo/redo → audible playback, and the full path to a WAV export that is not silent. C also checks unknown parameters, a narrow window, page errors against HEAD, the change in visible text, and that the Studio still opens without sign-in while purchased tracks stay protected.

**Split and next steps**
- The approved request is split in two. Round 297 is STUDIO-LINK-b: "View in store" from the Studio library item's right-click/keyboard menu, opening in a new tab, plus a row in the `?` sheet.
- I didn't write an AGREE note: this request already has Saba's exact approved scope, and Ableton has no store hand-off to compare against.
- I found no store product that links into an in-browser editor with the item preselected (Epidemic Sound, Splice), so the task says "no reference found".
- product-designer was consulted. I dropped its screen-reader-only announcement because focusing the selected item already announces it.
- Three of Saba's choices are applied as defaults while waiting for his answer (SABA-Q-STUDIO-LINK):
  - the link sits under the product title;
  - products without a Studio preview show no link;
  - "View in store" opens a new tab.
- Order after this round:
  1. **REGRESSION**, if the next planning is on or after 2026-11-02
  2. STUDIO-LINK-b
  3. NAME-AND-HINT
  4. PERF-3c and the rest of STUDIO-PERFORMANCE
  5. STEM-LANES
  6. SYS-1…3
  7. STORE-2b…5 (Saba already chose direction A)
  8. REVIEW-RECOMMENDATIONS, T12-ADVANCED, then phase 2

  The next retrospective is at round 305. No architecture checkpoint is needed yet.

The advisor was available and consulted twice. All the changes described above are in place. `lessons.md` is unchanged at 59 lines.
